answer: A sybil-resistant economy can scale each answer's reward by how different its mechanism is from all earlier answers across every author. The space of good ideas is finite, like a karst whose caves are mostly mapped, so a farm's many heads end up competing with one another for the same few unexplored pockets. Splitting into more keys divides the available novelty instead of multiplying it. One lotus in an untouched pool earns more than a canyon full of echoes.
